claims.text: The hotel is at the crossroads of the Orchard Road shopping belt, the Singapore Botanic Gardens and the Embassy District.

findings.quote: is at the crossroads of the famed Orchard Road shopping belt and the Singapore Botanic Gardens, a World UNESCO Heritage Site, and the Embassy District

claims.text: The hotel is located one block from Orchard Road.

findings.quote: Located one block from Orchard Road, our luxury Singapore hotel near the shopping district

claims.text: The St. Regis Singapore officially opened in 2008.

findings.quote: The St. Regis Singapore officially opened in 2008

claims.text: Room interiors use botanical references, with calming tones of blue and aqua, timber-wood flooring and bespoke furnishings.

findings.quote: The interiors infuse botanical references with modern design, where calming tones of blue and aqua, timber-wood flooring, and bespoke furnishings create a residential atmosphere.

claims.text: Every guest room has a marble bathroom with double vanities, a standing shower and a separate bathtub.

findings.quote: Every guest room is furnished with a study desk, a 65-inch TV, a marble bathroom with double vanities, a standing shower, a separate bathtub

claims.text: Rooms have potable hot and cold water on tap, a casting-enabled TV and a Bluetooth sound bar.

findings.quote: New room features include potable hot and cold water on tap, a casting-enabled TV and a Bluetooth sound bar.

claims.text: Sophia, the Italian restaurant, has a dining room inspired by a glasshouse.

findings.quote: Inspired by a glasshouse, Sophia’s captivating, verdant dining room sets the stage for refined Italian favourites.

claims.text: Tentsuru, led by Chef Daiki Kawaguchi, showcases seasonal ingredients flown in fresh from Japan.

findings.quote: Tentsuru showcases seasonal ingredients air-flown fresh from Japan. Led by Chef Daiki Kawaguchi

claims.text: Afternoon tea at The Tea Room features unlimited scones, artisanal jams and clotted cream.

findings.quote: The afternoon tea ritual features unlimited scones, artisanal jams and clotted cream.
The Tea Room serves afternoon tea in Singapore near Orchard Road

claims.text: The St. Regis Spa has indoor and outdoor jacuzzis, cedarwood Finnish saunas and eucalyptus steam chambers.

findings.quote: Our extensive spa facilities include indoor and outdoor jacuzzis, cedarwood Finnish saunas and eucalyptus steam chambers.

claims.text: The outdoor pool is on level 2.

findings.quote: Located on level 2, enjoy a refreshing dip in our sparkling pool

claims.text: The Family Traditions program gives guests aged 12 and under amenities such as bathrobes, bedroom slippers and bath essentials.

findings.quote: Especially curated for our younger guests aged 12 and under, the Family Traditions program presents thoughtful amenities such as plush bathrobes, cozy bedroom slippers, and bath essentials

claims.text: The hotel has a private art collection of more than 70 works, from Pablo Picasso and Marc Chagall to Singaporean and Asian artists such as Georgette Chen, Anthony Poon and Li Chen.

findings.quote: The St. Regis Singapore is home to a distinguished private art collection of more than 70 works of art.
from modern masters like Pablo Picasso and Marc Chagall, to acclaimed Asian and Singaporean artists like Georgette Chen, Anthony Poon and Li Chen

claims.text: A complimentary butler-led hotel art tour runs daily; advance reservation is required.

findings.quote: A complimentary butler-led hotel art tour is available on property at 5:30 PM daily. An advanced reservation is required

claims.text: A champagne sabrage ritual takes place on the Grand Staircase every evening.

findings.quote: the art of sabrage is the signature ceremony of the St. Regis Evening Rituals series. Come take part in this revered ritual at the Grand Staircase at 6:30 PM daily.
daily evening champagne sabrage

claims.text: The Straits Mary, the hotel's local twist on the Bloody Mary, features bak kwa-infused whisky and chilli padi.

findings.quote: Our local twist, The Straits Mary is a smoky deconstructed riff featuring bak kwa-infused whisky, chilli padi, and a medley of spices.
The Straits Mary, our local interpretation of the Bloody Mary

claims.text: Complimentary butler services include packing and unpacking of luggage, beverage service, daily garment pressing and shoe shine.

findings.quote: complimentary butler services including packing and unpacking of your luggage; beverage service upon arrival and in the mornings; daily garment pressing of two pieces daily; shoe shine service

claims.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.

findings.quote: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

claims.text: The nearest MRT stations, Orchard and Orchard Boulevard, are about a 10-minute walk away.

findings.quote: The MRT stations (Orchard or Orchard Boulevard) are a 10-minute walk away

claims.text: A teepee tent can be set up in family rooms for an additional charge.

findings.quote: families travelling with children can opt to have a teepee tent set up in their rooms, complete with a galaxy night light for a cozy retreat (additional charges apply)
